environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'card-service-input-validation' with priority 1 that inspects query string parameters using a RegexPatternSet matching common vm/eval breakout patterns (this\.constructor, process, require, child_process, Function\(, eval\(). Additionally, the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet is attached at priority 5 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to BLOCK at 512 bytes. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule group has been triggering BLOCK actions in production for 90+ days with zero false positives on legitimate card preview traffic.

waf_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
waf_rules.override: SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING set to BLOCK at 512 bytes

config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
